translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: etwas mit Wasser oder anderen Flüssigkeiten reinigen, entfernen

glosses: To wash (something) quickly using water and no soap.

examples.text: You'd better rinse that stain before putting the shirt in the washing machine.

glosses: To remove soap from (something) using water.

examples.text: Rinse the dishes after you wash them.

glosses: To drink and hangout with friends.

examples.text: Let's Rinse later tonight at my house.

glosses: To swish (a liquid) around the inside of something.

examples.text: Oscar uncapped his beer, rinsed the first mouthful around.

glosses: To thoroughly defeat in an argument, fight or other competition.

examples.text: You got rinsed.
I think that's a British thing though. Like, I got rinsed for playing video games.

glosses: The action of rinsing.

examples.text: I'll just give this knife a quick rinse.

glosses: A liquid used to rinse, now particularly a hair dye.

examples.text: I had a henna rinse yesterday.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: etwas mit Wasser oder anderen Flüssigkeiten reinigen, entfernen

glosses: To wash the inside of something.

examples.text: We must wash out the bins; they are full of maggots.
This engine, and the branch engine, were washed out regularly after six days' work by the pumpman (but not on a Monday) the spare engine being used to cover their normal duties on such occasions.

glosses: To remove something by washing.

examples.text: He washed out the stain.

glosses: To be removed by washing.

examples.text: That stain washed out easily.

glosses: To wear away by the flow of water; to erode.

examples.text: The sandcastle was washed out by the tide.
The railway, which is single track throughout, skirts the left bank of the estuary of the River Colne, and was washed out over a length of about three miles.
Storm Jorge on February 29-March 1 washed out lines at Dutton Viaduct, Mountain Ash and around Aberdare.

glosses: To cancel due to bad weather.

examples.text: The continuous rain washed out the cricket match.

glosses: To lose traction while going around a turn, especially in cycling, motorsports and skiing/snowboarding.

examples.text: The rider washed out around that last turn and hit a tree.

glosses: To fail utterly at something one has attempted.

examples.text: Après lui avoir massé le cuir chevelu pendant une bonne minute, elle lui remit la tête sous le jet en s'attachant à ne pas crisper les doigts pendant qu'elle le rinçait.

examples.text: Se rincer la bouche, se laver la bouche avec un liquide que l'on recrache.
